environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with a Function URL where AuthType is set to AWS_IAM. The resource-based policy on the function specifies lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl with a Condition block requiring aws:PrincipalOrgID matching the organization ID (o-abc123def4). No additional identity policy grants lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl to any principal outside the organization. The function URL endpoint returns HTTP 403 with body '{"Message":"Forbidden"}' for any request that does not include a valid SigV4 signature from an IAM principal within the specified organization. Note: the function code itself is identical and still contains the CRLF injection path — the control operates at the invocation authorization layer before the handler executes.
